# Digital Footprint Health Report · 数字足迹体检报告
> Upload your X/Twitter archive and generate a local privacy health report. Auto-detect risky tweets (phone numbers, emails, addresses, locations) with on-demand batch deletion. Your data never leaves your device.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/): Upload X archive → generate privacy score → batch delete risky tweets (Chinese)
- [English Home](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/en): Same tool, English interface
- [Upload Archive](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/upload): Upload your X/Twitter tweets.csv or tweets.js
- [Delete Confirmation](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/delete/confirm): Confirm and pay for tweet deletion

## Privacy & Legal
- [Privacy Policy](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/privacy): Data handling policy — all processing is local, no server upload
- [FAQ](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/faq): 12 frequently asked questions about digital footprint privacy

## Blog
- [How to Delete Old Tweets — 2026 Complete Guide](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/blog/how-to-delete-old-tweets-2026): Chinese guide covering 5 methods (manual, cloud service, browser extension, local archive, custom script) with comparison table

## About
- [About Us](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/about): Mission, principles, tech stack, contact info

## Technical
- [Sitemap](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engines
- [Robots](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/robots.txt): Crawler rules
- [Open Graph Image](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/opengraph-image.png): Auto-generated OG image (1200×630)

## Tech Stack
- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router)
- **Auth:** Supabase
- **Deploy:** Vercel Edge Network
- **Payment:** Stripe + PayPal
- **Data Processing:** 100% local browser-side (no server upload)
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4
